question: Which of the following is a component of phloem tissue?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sieve tubes**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Phloem** is a complex permanent tissue in vascular plants that transports organic nutrients (mainly sucrose) from the leaves to other parts of the plant.
 
• **Sieve tubes** are the primary conducting elements of phloem. They are long, tubular structures formed by a series of sieve tube elements arranged end-to-end.
 
• The end walls of sieve tube elements have perforations called **sieve plates**, which facilitate the flow of nutrients and other substances between cells.
 
• Unlike xylem, which primarily transports water, phloem transports **both nutrients and signaling molecules** to various parts of the plant.
 
• Other components of phloem tissue include companion cells, phloem parenchyma, and phloem fibers&l
